The speech is unscripted, accented and full of political and institutional vocabulary, which is exactly what makes it a hard, realistic board. Runs on this corpus are capped at 2,000 clips, drawn with a pinned seed so every fighter is scored on the same ones; a split smaller than the cap is scored in full.
